summary:
CPR-FINDINGS-UX-1 v2 Workstream B7/B9/C1/B6 verified end-to-end on WEB with cathy@example.com and the Robert Henderson golden fixture. B7 cp-plan-summary card renders correctly with a plain-English sentence ('This is a Support at Home care plan for Robert, Classification 5. It covers 01/01/2027 to 31/03/2027. The plan provides 2 services across Clinical, Independence, with a quarterly budget of $9924.25. Overall, the plan appears to meet the flagship checks. See the findings below.'). B9 cp-download-summary click triggers a real PDF download (23,155 bytes, %PDF- magic verified, filename wayly-care-plan-review-2026-08-21.pdf, no error toast). B6 filter bar at /app/care-plans renders all four widgets (cp-filters, cp-search, cp-filter-classification, cp-filter-flagged); garbage search 'zzz_no_match_xxx' correctly triggers empty-state with EXACT copy 'No plans match your filters.'; 'Compliance flags only' toggle reduces 40→24 rows; Classification=8 filter reduces to 14 rows; clearing filters returns to 40 rows. Verification panel (cp-verification-panel from prior iter238 scope) and findings (cp-finding-0..8, 9 findings) still render alongside the new B7 card. MOBILE: not automated (source-review parity per handoff — Expo web-preview SecureStore auth injection remains blocked from iter235-238). Source verified: /app/mobile/src/components/tools/CarePlanReviewer.tsx line 318 renders <Card testID='cp-plan-summary'>, line 382 renders per-finding testID='cp-draft-letter-${i}' that router.push()es to /correspondence/${entry_id}; /app/mobile/app/care-plans.tsx line 99 renders testID='cp-filters' with cp-search and equivalent controls — 1:1 parity with web.

=== ONE ISSUE FOUND ===
C1 'Draft letter about this' buttons DID NOT render for ANY of the 9 findings in this fixture. Root cause is the render gate in /app/frontend/src/pages/tools/CarePlanReviewer.jsx:508 — `{access === 'allowed' && (f.addressee_primary || f.rule_id) && (...)}` — meaning the button only appears when the LLM populates `addressee_primary` OR `rule_id` on the finding. On the Robert Henderson golden fixture (paste-text path, Classification 5, $9,924.25) the returned findings include compliance-flavoured items (e.g. 'Domestic Assistance Not Included Despite Assessed Need', 'No After-Hours Coverage Listed for Participant Living Alone', 'Nursing Hours May Be Insufficient for Wound Management') but NONE of them arrive with an addressee_primary/rule_id, so zero cp-draft-letter buttons are rendered. Because the buttons never render, the navigation-to-LF-1-editor flow could not be exercised on the FE. Backend already curl-verified per handoff (POST /api/care-plans/letter-from-finding returns {entry_id, editor_path:/tools/letters-and-follow-ups/<id>}), so this is a data-population / UX gate issue, not an integration/backend bug.

ui_bugs.issue: C1 'Draft letter about this' button never rendered for any of the 9 findings on the Robert Henderson golden fixture because the LLM output does not populate addressee_primary or rule_id on findings, and the render gate at CarePlanReviewer.jsx:508 requires (f.addressee_primary || f.rule_id). Result: cp-draft-letter-<i> data-testid count = 0 on a real review. LF-1 handoff flow cannot be exercised through the UI on this fixture.

integration_issues.issue: Carry-over from iter235-238: cannot inject kindred_token into SecureStore on Expo web preview, so UI automation cannot reach the authenticated surfaces. Not a shipped-code bug. Source parity confirmed 1:1 with web for cp-plan-summary card, cp-draft-letter-<i> handler, and cp-filters / cp-search on the register.

parity_issues.issue: Web pushes to /tools/letters-and-follow-ups/${entry_id} (matches backend `editor_path`); mobile pushes to /correspondence/${entry_id} (CarePlanReviewer.tsx line ~380). Not a bug — mobile has its own correspondence route — but the request specifies '/tools/letters-and-follow-ups/<entry_id>' as the navigation target, so flag the divergence for main-agent sign-off.

action_items: Investigate why the LLM output on the Robert Henderson golden fixture does NOT populate addressee_primary or rule_id on findings — either update the LLM prompt/schema so at least compliance/choice findings arrive with a default addressee_primary (e.g. 'provider') + rule_id, OR relax the FE gate in CarePlanReviewer.jsx:508 to show the button on every finding (with 'provider' as the default addressee). Without one of these, the C1 handoff flow is unreachable through the UI for real reviews.
Once the button renders on real findings, re-verify the click → POST /api/care-plans/letter-from-finding → navigation to /tools/letters-and-follow-ups/<entry_id> flow end-to-end.

(Parity) Decide whether mobile should navigate to /correspondence/<entry_id> (current) or to /tools/letters-and-follow-ups/<entry_id> (web/spec) after cp-draft-letter — if intentional, document the mobile-only route difference.
(Optional, out-of-scope) Suppress the dev-only React hydration warning on <select><option> in CarePlanReviewer.jsx — same carry-over class from iter236-238.
critical_code_review_comments:
B7 cp-plan-summary card is correctly wrapped in `(fileResult.plan_summary || fileResult.findings?.length > 0)` guard (CarePlanReviewer.jsx:424) so it renders even when plan_summary is missing but findings exist — good defensive UX. The plain-English summary from the backend is rendered verbatim via

— safe from injection.

B9 downloadSummary handler uses fetch → blob → object-URL anchor click → revokeObjectURL — canonical browser download pattern, sets 'Preparing…' loader state, and disables the button while busy. Verified: a real 23,155-byte PDF is delivered on the paste-text path.

B6 filter logic in CarePlanStore.jsx correctly combines search / classification / flaggedOnly and swaps the empty-state copy to 'No plans match your filters.' via `(query || classFilter || flaggedOnly)` guard (line 333). Empty-state suggestion CTA ('Upload your first plan') is correctly hidden when filters are active — good UX.

C1 render gate at CarePlanReviewer.jsx:508 is TOO STRICT for the current LLM output — a compliance-severity finding with no addressee_primary/rule_id currently shows NO way to draft a letter. Recommend either (a) relaxing to `access === 'allowed' && f.severity !== 'info'` with a 'provider' default addressee, or (b) updating the LLM contract to always populate addressee_primary on non-info findings.

Mobile /app/mobile/src/components/tools/CarePlanReviewer.tsx pushes to /correspondence/${entry_id} instead of /tools/letters-and-follow-ups/${entry_id} — inconsistent with backend `editor_path` and the web target. Should be reconciled.

success_rate.backend: N/A (skipped per request; backend curl 8/8 per handoff)
success_rate.frontend: web: B7 100%, B9 100%, B6 100% (search+empty-state copy, flagged toggle, classification filter all pass), C1 0% (button never renders on real fixture — LLM output gap). Mobile: source-parity 100%, UI automation blocked.

seed_data_creation: None. Cathy's household already has 20 active + 26 archived plans on the register — sufficient to exercise B6 filters and empty-state copy without seeding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: B7/B9/B6 are UI-verified on the paste-text golden path. The unresolved issue is the C1 render gate: findings on the Robert Henderson golden fixture do NOT contain addressee_primary/rule_id, so cp-draft-letter-<i> never renders and the LF-1 handoff cannot be exercised through the UI. When the main agent fixes either the LLM output or the FE gate, re-run /app/test_reports/iter239_cpr_web.py — the script already contains the click + navigation assertion for /tools/letters-and-follow-ups/. Also check the mobile /correspondence/<id> vs web /tools/letters-and-follow-ups/<id> parity. Mobile Expo web-preview SecureStore auth-injection issue is still open (same as iter235-238).
rca of the issue: B7 plan summary + B9 PDF download + B6 register filters all pass. The only miss is C1: /app/frontend/src/pages/tools/CarePlanReviewer.jsx line 508 gates the cp-draft-letter-<i> button on `f.addressee_primary || f.rule_id`. The current LLM output for the Robert Henderson golden fixture returns 9 findings but none carry addressee_primary/rule_id, so the button is never rendered — even for compliance-flavoured findings like 'Domestic Assistance Not Included Despite Assessed Need' or 'No After-Hours Coverage Listed for Participant Living Alone'. Fix at either layer (LLM contract or FE gate) will restore the C1 handoff. Backend endpoint itself is confirmed working per handoff.
